verdict.rationale: Logseq documents whole-graph export in open formats (EDN, JSON, standard Markdown, OPML, Roam JSON and HTML), and community users confirm their data lives in local markdown files they can keep in git. One user notes the new DB version no longer stores data as markdown files, and another calls the Markdown and Org backends non-standard; these are caveats on native storage, not evidence that export fails. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that full-graph export is complete and faithful (assets, whiteboards, DB-version properties), and evidence that the DB version's native storage stays plain open files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Exports the entire graph in the following formats: **EDN**... **JSON**... **Standard Markdown**... **OPML**... **Roam JSON**... **HTML**
It supports exporting text selections, blocks, individual pages, or the entire graph with customizable options.
The Logseq Export feature allows users to export their data in various formats, including text, HTML, OPML, PNG, EDN, JSON, and standard Markdown.
